design.models: Frozen Full s02/u32 and Flat-MLP+C128 s01/u32, greedy legal actions; archived grade-revised path-flow-matching with its published settings and legal fallback. No learning or advance information about outage duration.
design.common_random_numbers: Each seed is shared by the nine native shifts. Distinct run, recording and configuration bytes per shift. Compare pre-outage dispatch observations and physical business events within strategy; require identical pre-outage trajectories for the deterministic neural actors. For the original wall-clock-limited flow solver, report any prefix mismatches and diagnostics, and retain all assigned pairs in the primary analysis. Pair inference by the preassigned environment seed.
design.stopping_rule: 30 prespecified slots irrespective of observed results; report any incomplete slot. No post hoc seed selection.

endpoints.joint: Boolean: crushed ore and discharged waste within their pre-existing targets/tolerance and all four fixed crushed-grade windows compliant (26-28%).
endpoints.wait: Cumulative waiting for load/unload service over all nine trucks over the eight-hour shift, in vehicle-hours. Suspended active service is reported separately.
endpoints.grade: Sample standard deviation in percentage points of the four fixed two-hour mass-weighted crushed-ore grades, with divisor 3. When a window has zero crushed ore, treat its grade as undefined and report effective n for continuous grade analysis; it cannot satisfy joint compliance.
endpoints.supporting: Four-window pass, per-window grade compliance and means, ore and waste tonnes, high-site loading, in-service suspension; by-policy internal fallback and zero native invalid/backup dispatches.

inference.primary: At 60 minutes: Full vs flow and Full vs Flat on joint compliance, exact paired McNemar and Holm across two tests.
inference.within_policy: For each of joint, wait and grade, compare 30-0 and 60-0 within each strategy; Holm across six tests per endpoint.
inference.severity_interaction: For each baseline and each of joint, wait and grade, compare Full-baseline gap at 60 versus its gap at 30, using paired within-slot differences of differences; Holm across six tests.
inference.continuous_policy_impacts: Contrast Full vs each baseline on increments from 0 to 30 and 0 to 60 for wait and grade; Holm across eight tests.
inference.continuous_test: Two-sided paired sign-flip test of the mean difference under exchangeability. Enumerate <=16 nonzero differences, otherwise 100000 fixed-seed Monte Carlo permutations with plus-one correction; discrete integer interaction contrasts use exact sign-flip convolution.
inference.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for cell rates. Binary difference interval by conservative simultaneous Clopper-Pearson bounds on probabilities of paired gains and losses, clipped to [-1,1]. Other mean contrasts: 20000 paired percentile bootstrap resamples of environmental slots, nominal 95% intervals. These are pointwise intervals; use Holm-adjusted p-values for the declared hypothesis families.
inference.unit: one environment seed (not windows or individual dispatches)
inference.scope: fixed trained weights, the A map, and the stated shock times. No guarantee of significance or ordered degradation.
